workflow_runs.name: Android Build
workflow_runs.display_title: fix: stop Kakao SDK fallback masking REST failures on Android

head_commit.message:
fix: stop Kakao SDK fallback masking REST failures on Android

Native Capacitor WebView cannot load Kakao Maps JS SDK without a
registered domain, so REST errors were overwritten by KAKAO_SDK_LOAD_FAIL.
Skip SDK on native, harden CapacitorHttp, and surface the real REST error.

fix: await ListenableFuture via .get() for GenAI Rewriting CI build
